tasks.notes: The comments above each function are the exact rule and the constants are final. Remove the void lines and the stub returns. shareOut: return SHARE.find((b) => hour < b.to).share. threshold: return (i * GOLDEN) % 1. commuteGoal: hour >= RUSH_AM[0] && hour < RUSH_AM[1] gives person.job === null ? null : parcels[person.job]; hour >= RUSH_PM[0] && hour < RUSH_PM[1] gives parcels[person.home]; otherwise null. commuteLabel uses the same two windows and returns the strings 'heading to work' (only when person.job !== null) and 'heading home'. tickCommute: compute shareOut(hour) once, then street.npcs.forEach((n, i) => ...) following the comment; return early for a walker whose axis is not 'z' or when people.list is empty, AFTER its out flag is set.
